fixes.detail: All 149 boulder_rim (and dressing[1] boulders, dressing[2] midstream rock_clusters) are snapped to the bed (z -44.8/-44.85). Their tops are near -43.9, 1-2 m under the surface (-42.0 to -43.0), so the banks render as bare smooth walls and there is no white water. Snap to the local water surface minus embed*h so about 60% shows above water.
The lip sheet stands on the bed and rises 17 m (-44.6 to -27.6), making a black wall across the river's end (strip 7, concept). It must hang down from the lip: top -43.0, bottom -60.0.

j2_inflow sheet base is at bed -44.6 (top -34.6, 2.6 m short of the slot, bottom 2.6 m under water). Set z_top -32 / bottom -42 (dz +2.6), give it white-teal emission with the inflow_uplight, and re-aim the entry camera about 40 deg right (target about (182, 97, -37)) so the cascade is in frame. north_trickle has the same z error (dz +2.6).

Mist cards use a fixed z -42.6, below the surface upstream of x about 95 (surface -42.0 to -42.6), so they are sunk at the head where mist should be densest. The ones that show render as opaque white balls. Use z = local surface, a flat translucent card, and density higher at the head, under the deck and at the lip.

Stone lanterns come in near-mirrored pairs across the head reach (1:7/1:10, 1:6/1:11, 1:5/1:12, 1:4/1:13), so the river reads as a regular canal. Stagger the sides (no two within 4 m of x on opposite banks), spacing [7,15], and cluster 2-3 at the cascade foot.

top_change: Seat the river's content on the water surface: hang both falls sheets from their lips (inflow -32 to -42, Thunder lip -43 to -60, both lit white) and raise boulders, rocks and mist from the bed, so the banks, white water and the two cascades actually show.
plausibility: thunder_lip and j2_inflow/north_trickle falls sheets stand upward from the riverbed instead of hanging from their lips.
All rim boulders and midstream rocks are fully submerged.
Mist cards upstream are below the water surface.
The boat route/centreline passes under the Kawagiri spine deck with about 1.5 m clearance. Either end the boat route at the landing (x 124) or treat the downstream strip as water-only.
